Types

BundleConfig = object
  minify*: bool
  mangle*: bool
  bundle*: bool
  validate*: bool
  treeShake*: bool
  preserveComments*: bool
  sourceMap*: bool
  entryPoint*: string
  outputPath*: string
  format*: OutputFormat      ## Output wrapper format for the bundled JS. Defaults to fmtES.
  moduleName*: string        ## Global/module name for iife/umd wrappers.
                             ## Defaults to the entry file basename when empty.
  externals*: seq[string] ## Bare specifiers left untouched (e.g. node builtins or
                          ## packages provided by the host). Never resolved.
  nodePaths*: seq[string]    ## Extra lookup roots checked before walked-up node_modules.
JsGenOptions = object
  minify*: bool
  mangle*: bool
  preserveComments*: bool
  sourceMap*: bool
  stripExports*: bool ## When true, codegen drops import/export statements and emits
                      ## declarations without the `export` keyword (for wrapped formats).
  preserveNames*: seq[string] ## Identifiers the mangler must leave untouched, e.g. a bundle
                              ## wrapper global (`--name`). Empty by default.
OutputFormat = enum
  fmtES = "es",             ## ES modules — native import/export preserved
  fmtCJS = "cjs",           ## CommonJS — module.exports / exports
  fmtIIFE = "iife",         ## Browser IIFE — var NAME = (function(exports){ ... })({})
  fmtUMD = "umd",           ## Universal — CJS/AMD/global factory wrapper
  fmtAMD = "amd",           ## AMD — define(['exports'], function(exports){ ... })
  fmtSystem = "system"       ## SystemJS — System.register([], function(exports){ ... })
